title: GEODES Extension
description: STAC GEODES Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections: fields of the CNES GEODES catalog that no other STAC extension covers, and the GEODES keys of the common metadata Statistics Object.

oneOf.$comment: STAC Items: GEODES fields in the item properties.

geodes:visibility.description: Item-level access tier asserted by the data provider. Consumed by GEODES access policies (schemas/policies/v1/) to gate read and download. 'public' items are accessible to anyone; 'private' items require an authenticated user with the right Keycloak group (typically the collection's group, e.g. 'co3d'); 'expert' items are reserved for expert-tier audiences (e.g. FLATSIM_*_VD_EXPERT). Providers are responsible for setting this field correctly at ingestion.

geodes:provider_id.description: External catalog identifier assigned by the originating provider (e.g., CDSE product ID). Used for traceability.

geodes:provider_dissemination_datetime.description: Datetime at which the provider published the product, in RFC 3339 format. Distinct from processing:datetime.

require_any_field.$comment: An Item that declares this extension carries at least one GEODES field or statistics.

^(?!geodes:).$comment: Do not allow other fields with this prefix
Do not allow other fields with this prefix

statistics.description: GEODES keys of the STAC common metadata Statistics Object (Item properties 'statistics'). All values are percentages (0-100), except interpolated_columns (a count). Other keys of the Statistics Object stay allowed.

nodata_pixel.description: Percentage of no-data pixels. Equal to 100 - valid_percent.

saturated_defective_pixel.description: Percentage of saturated or defective pixels.

ground_useful_pixel.description: Percentage of useful ground pixels (not cloud, not no-data).

min_useful_pixel.description: Minimum useful pixel percentage, as defined by the data provider.

interpolated_columns.description: Number of image columns restored by interpolation between neighbouring columns (dead detectors). A count, not a percentage.
